pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Initial CIG with 1 CIS support in LLL
pr_body:
Add initial support for CIG with 1 CIS in nRF5 SoC's LLL.

Supports Encryption.

Fixed Controller Implementation to be able to make Broadcast ISO and Connected ISO combined builds.

Fixes #53446.
Fixes #52351.
Fixes #42896.
Fixes #42900.
Fixes #42906.
Fixes #42907.
Fixes #42910.

Signed-off-by: Vinayak Kariappa Chettimada <vich@nordicsemi.no>
pr_comments: @cvinayak Noting https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/52842#pullrequestreview-1272612499, would you prefer to get this in for 3.3? or later?

> @cvinayak Noting [#52842 (review)](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/52842#pullrequestreview-1272612499), would you prefer to get this in for 3.3? or later?

@stephanosio The goal is v3.3, please merge. I am suspecting this PR is not failing on building all `integration_platforms` in sample.yaml file. But if CI breaks after the merge, I will fix as a github issue. (btw, I asked this morning in discord CI channel, but got no reply)

@niag-Oticon do you know why ISOAL status is bitfields?

I think it's from the original prototype development of ISO-AL. As far as I know, status shall never be a combination of bits, and thus should not be bitfields. However, I would go with @Thalley's suggestion.
Internally, bit-wise operands are used before returning the value, I am cautious and keep the change until ISOAL is updated to not use bit-wise operations.
Agreed. This PR should follow the current implementation, and this should be fixed in a separate PR. Should we create a GH issue for it?
